home.built.budget.body: Every build has a hard token budget per size. When it runs out the build stops — it never silently costs more.
home.built.budget.title: Hard budgets
home.built.delivery.body: You get a GitHub repository, a running URL, a handover document and a test report. No lock-in to us.
home.built.delivery.title: Real deliverables
home.built.failClosed.body: If a gate fails or the budget is spent, the build stops and you are told. Nothing half-finished is delivered as done.
home.built.failClosed.title: Fails closed
home.built.honest: We are a small, new company. The factory is still being built and its first real customers will be pilots — we say so up front rather than showing you logos and testimonials we do not have.
home.built.lead: No magic, no black box. This is what actually happens when you press start.
home.built.review.body: An independent review agent checks every build against your spec before it can pass a gate. The builder never grades its own work.
home.built.review.title: Independent review
home.built.sandbox.body: Each build runs in its own sandboxed container on AWS Fargate with restricted network access. Your code never shares a box with anyone else's.
home.built.sandbox.title: Sandboxed builds
home.built.sdk.body: Builds are run by AI coding agents on the Claude Agent SDK, working from a plan derived from your frozen spec.
home.built.sdk.title: Claude Agent SDK
home.built.title: What actually happens when you press start
home.cta.body: Sign in with your email, describe what you need, and get a fixed price. No commitment until you approve the spec.
home.cta.title: Ready to write your spec?
home.hero.eyebrow: Software to spec, at a fixed price
home.hero.lead: You describe what you need in the portal. We turn it into a frozen spec with a fixed quote — for free. Sandboxed AI agents build it under hard budgets and quality gates, and you get a working app on a running URL. Try it with a 500 SEK demo.
home.hero.title: A software factory that builds what you specify.
home.ladder.lead: The spec and the quote are free — you know the exact price before paying anything. Then each step is small enough to just try.
home.ladder.note: Orders under 3 000 SEK are paid in full upfront; from 3 000 SEK you pay half before the build and half on delivery. If the build fails our gates, you do not pay the delivery payment. All prices in SEK excluding VAT.
home.ladder.title: Small steps instead of a big project
home.what.build.body: Sandboxed AI agents build against the spec in small steps, each one checked by an independent review agent. You follow the progress live in the portal.
home.what.build.title: We build under hard limits
home.what.deliver.body: You get a working app on a running URL, a GitHub repository, a handover document and the test report.
home.what.deliver.title: You get the code and a running app
home.what.spec.body: In the portal you chat with our spec engine until the spec is complete. It asks the questions a good developer would. Then it is frozen and priced.
home.what.spec.title: You write a spec
home.what.title: From a description to a working application
howItWorks.faq.changes.a: A frozen spec is frozen — that is what makes the price fixed. Changes after freezing are a new spec and a new order, usually a small one.
howItWorks.faq.changes.q: Can I change the spec after it is frozen?
howItWorks.faq.code.a: You do. The repository is transferred to your GitHub account (we help you set one up if you do not have one). You can keep developing it with anyone you like.
howItWorks.faq.fail.a: Then the build stops and you are told what failed. You never pay a delivery payment for a build that has not passed the gates, and a failed demo build is ours to put right. We look at why together and agree on the next step.
howItWorks.faq.hosting.a: The delivered app runs on a URL we provide. With the managed subscription (600 SEK/month) we keep hosting and supporting it. Without it, you take the repository and run the app in your own cloud account — the handover document tells you how.
howItWorks.faq.hosting.q: Where does the app run afterwards?
howItWorks.faq.login.a: With a magic link sent to your email — no password. BankID sign-in is planned.
howItWorks.faq.title: Questions we get asked
howItWorks.lead: Six steps from an idea to a running application. You always know where you are and what it costs.
howItWorks.step.build.body: AI agents build against the plan in isolated containers. Every step is reviewed by an independent agent before the next one starts. You follow progress, budget use and gate results live in the portal.
howItWorks.step.build.title: Build with live progress
howItWorks.step.delivery.body: You receive the running URL, the GitHub repository, a handover document and the test report. For orders of 3 000 SEK and up, the remaining 50 % is due on delivery.
howItWorks.step.delivery.title: Delivery
howItWorks.step.deposit.body: Orders under 3 000 SEK are paid in full through Stripe; from 3 000 SEK you pay a 50 % deposit. Either way, the build cannot start before the money is in.
howItWorks.step.deposit.title: Payment
howItWorks.step.freeze.body: When the spec is complete you freeze it. The size (S, M or L) and the fixed price follow from the frozen spec — no surprises later.
howItWorks.step.freeze.title: Frozen spec and fixed price
howItWorks.step.qa.body: The build must pass our gates: the tests it writes, a build from scratch, a review against the spec and a security check. If a gate fails, the build stops. Nothing half-done is delivered.
howItWorks.step.qa.title: Quality gates
howItWorks.step.spec.body: Sign in to the portal and describe what you need. The spec engine asks follow-up questions until every requirement is clear and testable.
howItWorks.step.spec.title: Spec chat
howItWorks.title: From spec to delivery in six steps

pricing.lead: The spec and the quote are free, a demo costs 500 SEK, and a full build is 3 000–5 000 SEK — never more. All prices in SEK excluding VAT.

pricing.managed.note: The subscription is set up together with us at delivery — it is not self-service yet.
pricing.managed.point.awsResources.body: If your app needs more than the basics — more storage, a bigger database — the extra AWS resources are billed at cost plus 20 %.
pricing.managed.point.awsResources.title: Extra cloud resources
pricing.managed.point.editWork.body: Want changes to the app? An AI agent makes them under our supervision. You pay for the compute the work actually uses, times 1.5 — metered and itemised on your invoice, no hourly rates.
pricing.managed.point.editWork.title: AI edit work
pricing.managed.point.hosting.body: Your app runs in its own AWS account that we operate: deployments, monitoring and keeping it healthy are on us.
pricing.managed.point.hosting.title: Hosting & operations
pricing.managed.point.support.body: Something unclear or broken? Email us and a human looks at it.
pricing.managed.point.support.title: Support
pricing.managed.title: Managed — 600 SEK per month
